races.verdict: FANDOM went close over C&D 2 starts back and could be the way to go with a line put through last week's Stewards' Cup run. All Ways Glamorous didn't see another rival here a fortnight ago and is a big player in his hat-trick bid. Kendall Roy and Bolo Neighs are also in the mix. FANDOM ALL WAYS GLAMOROUS KENDALL ROY

races.verdict: This is wide open. FRANKIES DREAM hasn't enjoyed the rub of the green on his last 2 runs at York and Ascot and can now capitalise on a handy-looking mark and gain a first win of 2026. races.verdict: ROCKONLIAM has thrived of late, following a handicap hurdle success at Listowel with a smooth 14-runner maiden chase victory here 39 days ago, jumping soundly throughout. Whilst this represents a significant step up in trip, he remains open to further improvement and can go in again. Teenage Kiss and Rue Taylor , who fought out the finish of a handicap here in June head the list of dangers. ROCKONLIAM (IRE) TEENAGE KISS (IRE) RUE TAYLOR (FR)
